## Why this plugin exists

DSH's native **Order by → Last updated** orders sessions inside each workspace,
not the workspace fo

lders themselves. This plugin adds an independent ordering
choice without overwriting the host's sav
ed manual workspace order.

## Workspace name quick-open

When a workspace is **collapsed**, clicking its **name** expands it and opens
its latest non-archive

d session by session update time. Provisional blank
sessions are skipped; an empty workspace simply

expands. Clicking the arrow,
folder glyph, or empty row area keeps native expand/collapse-only behav

ior.
Workspace action buttons are untouched. Clicking the name of an already
expanded workspace keep

s native collapse behavior. Modified clicks do not
trigger auto-navigation. This does not change the
saved session ordering.
## Running workspace indicator

Workspace folder icons glow **green** while any member session is running,
even when the workspace i

s collapsed. A selected-but-idle session does not
trigger the glow. Running child agents listed in a

member session's subagent
catalog also count. The indicator follows DSH's live session-status store

and
clears when the work stops. It works with either workspace-order choice.

The glow is steady (no flashing animation). Only the folder glyph receives
color and shadow; native

row selection, labels, and session indicators remain
unchanged. It does not imply a workspace has me

rely been selected. The
implementation and status aggregation are unit-tested; the full running →
id

le transition still needs a real-agent browser test. The sidebar smoke suite
passes with the indicat
or wrapper installed.
## The Workspace order menu
| Option | Effect |

| **Manual workspace order** (default) | Displays the host's saved manual order. |
| **Last used wor
kspace** | Latest member-session activity first; empty workspaces last and ties in manual order. |
The native session-order choice remains independent. See the limitations below.
> **0.1.3 candidate — not published by this change.** Published 0.1.0 failed real-browser activation
in a clean DSH profile; avoid enabling it. The corrected candidate passes 10/10 real-browser smoke
checks and 4/4 post-uninstall checks on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. Broader coexistence and interaction testing
remains pending. See RELEASE.md.
Independent workspace ordering in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's existing **View options** popup, be
low its session-order options.

- **Workspace order → Manual workspace order** retains the host's saved order (default).
- **Workspa
ce order → Last used workspace** displays workspaces newest first, by the latest `updatedAt` among t

heir member sessions. Empty workspaces sort last; ties retain manual order.
- Session ordering, grou

ping, archive filtering, pinning, search, rename and delete remain native.
- Preference is browser-l
ocal, persisted as `dsh-workspace-sorter.order.v1`. It synchronizes across tabs on the same origin.
- No network requests, credentials, session contents, or persistent host workspace changes.
## Compatibility and limitations
**Pinned internal adapter for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.** The native view-options menu has no public extension
slot. This plugin wraps the registered `WorkspaceBrowser` function, transforms the returned `ViewOp
tionsMenu`, and projects a sorted workspace snapshot. It preserves the original entry's injected ser
vices, child-slot permissions, locale, and store. It does not edit installed DSH bundles or manipula
te the DOM. This is an internal integration, not a stable public menu API; the adapter waits for nat
ive registration and leaves unmatched sidebar components untouched rather than failing application b
registration and leaves unmatched sidebar components untouched rather than failing application boot.
“Last used” is **latest session activity**, not merely clicking a folder. Activity includes archived
sessions. Workspace-tree mode keeps the native hierarchy and applies ordering within it. In flat mo
de there is no workspace list to reorder. Workspace drag commits are suppressed while Last used is a
ctive; switch to Manual before dragging. Session drag behavior remains native. The native drag affor
dance is still shown.
The UI additions are intentionally English-only. Full browser runtime/HMR and coexistence testing is
still required before release. A full refresh after enabling/disabling is required because the adap
ter changes the live component entry; automatic HMR is not claimed.
